posts.cooked:
Hello all,

  • Re-attempt - 2nd May, 2026, 6:00 p.m. to 8:00 p.m. IST (+5:30 GMT)
    [Chance given automatically, if you score less than 40 AND WERE PRESENT AND MADE A SUBMISSION]

The first reply to this post links all the resources & exam pattern.

FAQs -

  1. No of Questions in OPPE - 5 all compulsory and equal weightage (Marks are based on number of private test cases passed)

  2. Syllabus - Week 1-9 for both OPPE and reattempt as well.

  3. Exam will be conducted on OPPE VM (details will be shared by next week) -

    • Login to gmeet via mobile - All basic checks like any other OPPE
    • Login to exam portal - Give screen & webcam permissions & submit COC & instructions [MANDATORY] & keep it on for the entire duration of the exam. If your camera or screen-share stops in portal you will be marked for malpractice. Tab away count is fine.
    • Login to your exam vm (details will be mailed to you)
    • Follow same process as you did for BPTs for answering questions

  4. OPPE re-attempt - Given to everyone (repeat OPPE or new students) only if your score is less than 40 but were present in first OPPE and made a submission. But it will be more difficult compared to first exam to score full marks.

  5. Login to OPPE VM - follow the below

   cd .ssh
   ls 
   #check either of the two must be present id_ed25519.pub or id_rsa.pub
   cat id_ed25519.pub 
   #or 
   cat id_rsa.pub
   #copy the key and paste it to your vm
   #check above point if you don't know your vm

  1. Getting “Error creating user” - re-submit your key it will be fixed.

  2. Cannot attend exam on 25th April - Mail support from HERE from student id with proper proof. Don’t post here. Note: Second OPPE is more difficult!

  3. Course VM will not be accessible on the day of exam.

  4. Terminal - You can use any terminal. It should not be AI integrated and auto-suggestions turned off.

  5. Questions will be visible at 6 p.m. Access to OPPE VM will be available at 5 p.m.

  6. Command to see test cases in OPPE -
    Configure your vm - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=QTdF-vG0Q90

ptc(){
        batcat /opt/se2001/$(basename $(pwd))/public/*/*
}

  1. Need multiple windows use - tmux!

  2. Exam link - https://study.iitm.ac.in/ds/exam.html (SC link will be available 1 hr before exam)

Note: Please ensure your terminal has black background because the question text font will be white in color. https://youtu.be/vDtmGwidi48?t=729

@sayan - Please check this post if I have missed out any points or misinformed something.

All the best!

Thanks & Regards,
TAs
Ishan - @22f2001554
Mrinal - @Mrinal.exe
Swati

posts.name: Sayan Ghosh
posts.cooked:
Thanks Swati for the detailed post. I have made a few clarifications there and simplified ptc there. It would also be in everyone’s .bashrc for your benefit.

Further let me stress on this again, in case some students have elaborate plans of deliberately failing in Slot 1:

  • Slot 1 will be the default slot, it will have the expected level of difficulty in OPPE, you are expected to be able to score 100 in this if you have prepared correctly.
  • Slot 2 is not just another slot, it is only for people who have genuinely tried hard but have failed in first slot, it is for them to “just pass” the OPPE instead of repeating the course another term.
  • Slot 2 questions are NOT meant to be of a fixed difficulty level, you might be able to barely pass the OPPE but with a very poor score in this slot easier, but it will be way harder to score full marks (or even decent marks) in this paper.
  • You are recommended to sit for Slot 1 and try your best there, and not keep Slot 2 as a backup
  • If you simply attend Slot 1 and do no submissions - you will be considered absent and not get any slot 2
  • If you are absent in slot 1 - you will not get slot 2

all_posts.name: Swati Jain
all_posts.cooked:
@teeyeskay

  1. You will be sharing your entire screen so what you write on the terminal is completely visible. Any app that is open is completely visible.
  2. No, its just like BPTs. You have to write your script on your own.
  3. No, just do the following on your WSL
    cd .ssh
    cat id_rsa.pub
    Copy and paste on the website (link is on the mail sent to you) → Submit.
    Then copy the command from the website -
    ssh <roll_no>@se2001-oppe-room-<room_no>.study.iitm.ac.in
    and paste it your terminal to login.
